title: On Stopping at the bridge for the night
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：stop　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stop 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the researcher ① stopped at the bridge for the night year after year, and every student in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the researcher ② stops at the bridge for the night for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ stop at the bridge for the night at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ stopped at the bridge for the night before — a line in the paper for February 1948 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Stopping at the bridge for the night year after year, the researcher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ stop the quarrel before it began for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Stop the quarrel before it began at once and never mention it again.

By 1961 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the paper, and a new student from the next lab ⑧ stops the quarrel before it began year after year every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ stopped at the bridge for the night again when nobody else would.

⑩ To stop at the bridge for the night, my mother said in 1966, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the lab remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the lab forgets, somebody stops at the bridge for the night for the whole place again and somebody must stop at the bridge for the night year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 停下（一般过去式 stopped at the bridge for the night：1954 年研究员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 停下（一般现在 stops at the bridge for the night：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 停下（不定式 to stop at the bridge for the night：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 停下（过去完成时 had stopped at the bridge for the night：1948 年二月的研究报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 停下（动名词 stopping at the bridge for the night 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 阻止（stop the quarrel before it began：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去阻止在这场口角未起之前拦住）
G. v. 阻止（stop the quarrel before it began：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 停下（后段两处：新来的学生照例 stops the quarrel before it began，而母亲又一次 stopped at the bridge for the night）

answers.why: stop 意为“停下”，1954 年研究员年年地停下在桥头停下过夜，那是实验室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 stopped。
stop 意为“停下”，自那以后研究员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 stops。
stop 意为“停下”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯停下在桥头停下过夜”，此处为不定式 to stop at the bridge for the night。
stop 意为“停下”，研究报告里 二月 那行字说明早在 1961 年之前就有人停下过，故用过去完成时 had stopped。
stop 意为“停下”，研究员说“停下在桥头停下过夜这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 stopping at the bridge for the night 作主语。
stop 意为“阻止”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去阻止在这场口角未起之前拦住”，should ever 之后用原形 stop the quarrel before it began。
stop 意为“阻止”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻阻止在这场口角未起之前拦住（stop the quarrel before it began at once），以后再也不要提起。
stop 意为“停下”，新来的学生每个学期都照例阻止在这场口角未起之前拦住，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 stops。
stop 意为“停下”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地停下在桥头停下过夜，用一般过去式 stopped 叙述。
stop 意为“停下”，结尾那句是母亲 1966 年的话：要停下在桥头停下过夜，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和实验室记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 stop 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the researcher stopped at the bridge for the night year after year, and nobody in the lab forgot it.
Even now the researcher stops at the bridge for the night for the whole place whenever the lab asks.
Stopping at the bridge for the night year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever stop the quarrel before it began for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new student from the next lab stops the quarrel before it began year after year every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother stopped at the bridge for the night again, and the lab remembered that half.
